question: A business started with 101 dollars. They multiplied by 9 through growth. They added 58 dollars. They added 23 dollars from sales. They added 65 more from deals. They subtracted 776 for expenses. A loan of 1000 dollars was available but unused. After multiplication but before adding the first sales amount, how much did they have?

Early in the morning, the Casa Rosa food truck prepared 3 trays of tacos with 35 tacos on each tray. Late in the morning the cook made 69 more tacos, and at noon she made another 15. During the busy afternoon the truck sold 139 tacos. In the evening the cook made 24 more tacos for the late crowd. How many tacos did the truck have on hand at the end of the evening?

Two chefs collaborated. Starting ingredients: 129 portions. Multiplied by 7 for the week's menu. Multiplied by 3 for double-batch prep. Added 79 specialty items. Added 11 garnish portions. Multiplied by 4 for plating. Two team members supervised. How many plated servings prepared?

A vending company loads 143 cans onto each of the 5 shelves of a machine. There are 4 machines of that kind in the college. The company also left 60 spare cans in the college store. The college has 900 students. Demand was so high that the company doubled the whole stock it keeps at the college. A technician then added 3 cans he found in his van. How many cans are at the college now?

A librarian had 70 books to catalog. Morning cataloging added 6. Afternoon brought 71 more. Evening brought 18 additional books. Before closing, 46 were shelved. Two other sections had 34 books each (not counted). How many books remained to catalog?

A city recycling depot receives 224 sacks of cardboard from each of its 6 districts. Every sack holds 9 bundles, each bundle holds 4 packs, and each pack holds 7 flattened sheets. A school then delivered 80 loose sheets to the depot. During the week 188047 sheets were sent on to the paper mill. The depot runs a dozen collection lorries and employs 35 people. How many sheets of cardboard are left at the depot?

A courier service started with 185 packages (morning load). They added 16 (morning addition). They added 58 more (mid-morning). They doubled (multiplied by 2, afternoon). They multiplied by 8 for route calculation. They multiplied by 4 for final scaling (evening). Using 'minutes to hours' to track delivery time. After additions but before doubling, how many packages in the mid-morning?

A student had 174 flashcards for studying. In the morning, they removed 81 cards they had mastered, leaving 93. By midday, they added 18 new difficult cards, reaching 111. They multiplied their deck 3 times for practice to 333 cards. They multiplied 9 times again to 2,997 cards for a comprehensive review. They added 40 bonus cards. His friend studied 50 cards (separate deck). How many cards does the student have to study?

A builder had 63 materials. They removed 27 materials for the foundation. They removed 17 materials for framing. They removed 7 materials for roofing. They divided by 2 to calculate per-house needs. How many materials per house?

A juice stand began the morning with 96 cups sold. By midmorning, 44 more cups were sold, and the total was then multiplied across 4 identical pitchers, each holding that same amount, for a big event. A second event made that total grow to 3 times its size, unrelated to a nearby bakery that sold 200 muffins that same morning. The batch was then split evenly across 6 volunteers, and only one volunteer's share was tracked. Since the stand tracks cups sold but the recipe measures lemons by the dozen, the kids always converted between the two. That volunteer then sold 75 more cups, and a final rush added 41 more cups. How many cups had that volunteer sold in total?

A single toy warehouse started the month with 192 dolls in stock. A holiday order left the warehouse with 6 times as many dolls. A matching contract then tripled that count for a chain of stores. The dolls were then split evenly among 6 delivery trucks, and this story follows just one truck. That truck received 12 more dolls from a returned batch, and 16 more from a local donor, after a stop that took about 30 minutes, roughly half an hour. Finally, a bulk holiday order multiplied that truck's dolls by 9. How many dolls were on that truck in the end?

In the morning a shelter had 84 blankets, and a single van delivered 67 more. In the afternoon 140 blankets were handed out to families. In the evening a church sent 76 blankets and a school sent 78. How many blankets did the shelter have at the end of the evening?

A drama club raised money by selling tickets for its show. It sold 17 tickets on Monday, 23 on Tuesday, and 78 on Wednesday. The hall seats 200 people. Every ticket was sold for 9 dollars. A parent also gave the club a 22-dollar donation. How many dollars did the club raise altogether?
A factory had 48 units. They tripled. They quadrupled by 4 times. They divided by 2. They multiplied by 5 times. They doubled again. Someone had a dozen units. How many units?
A child had 26 toys. She removed 17. She removed 7 more. She added 37 back. She multiplied by 9. She removed 163. About 15 toys were broken, which is unrelated. How many toys?
A business started with 49 items. They tripled. They added 60 items. They increased 5 times. Finally, they added 9 items. A neighbor had 100 items. How many items do they have?

A team had 105 members initially. They removed 100 for restructuring. The remaining multiplied by 6 for expanded roles. They added 68 more members. Finally, 24 additional members joined. A larger organization had 1000 members but different structure. How many total team members?

In the morning, a warehouse had 84 crates of soda. By midday, a supplier's rush order multiplied the crates sevenfold. In the afternoon, 209 crates were shipped out to a grocery chain. By evening, a returning delivery brought back 66 crates. Overnight, a matching bulk order multiplied the remaining crates sevenfold again. How many crates were in the warehouse the next morning?

A warehouse began with 79 boxes. Morning added 54. This was multiplied by 6 for inventory processing. She added 59. She added 74. A sister location had 88 boxes (not included). She converted to dozens (a unit change). What was the final box total?
A workshop had 43 items. They added 35. They tripled. They added 28. They removed 204. How many items?

A store had 237 items. They multiplied by 5. They multiplied by 3 again. They removed 1379. They removed 1699 more. They multiplied by 6 for final distribution. Her store partner has 120 items separately. How many items are available?

Selina's print room turns out more envelopes than Marc's does. The tray held 195 envelopes, and a machine added 4 more. The works then produced 9 times that many envelopes for the mailing. Marc added 37 envelopes he had addressed by hand. The company now needs 6 mailings of exactly that size. How many envelopes will the 6 mailings need?

A value started at 225. In the morning, 213 were removed. By midday, the remaining divided in half. By afternoon, it octupled (multiplied by 8). By late afternoon, it doubled. By evening, 10 were added. His friend had 110 units. How many final?

Ingrid keeps more buttons in her sewing box than her sister Marta does. The box held 229 buttons until 147 were sewn onto a coat order. A haberdasher then tripled the number of buttons in the box. Marta borrowed 64 buttons for a costume and never brought them back. A theatre has now ordered 5 boxes, each holding as many buttons as Ingrid's box does. How many buttons will the theatre's order come to?

A conference organiser ordered 208 tables, and 200 of them went straight into the main hall, leaving the rest for the small workshop room. Each workshop table seats 6 delegates, and every delegate is given 8 handouts. Each handout runs to 8 printed pages. The printer then pulled out 451 pages that had been duplicated by mistake. The venue is 12 kilometres from the airport. How many pages are there in the workshop handouts?
